notes: One logical two-leg monthly oil/gas relative-value package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, density, and later Q09 correlation; neither component route is a standalone strategy.

The EA selects thirteen synchronized completed month-end oil-minus-gas log ratios, omits their unique median rank, counts every remaining chronological low/high regime run, and fades a nonmedian newest regime only at inclusive R<=7.
The package targets equal absolute notionals, caps combined frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget, and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket host-symbol recipe.
